name: Hydrating Pinwheel (Greater)
text:
Clear streams of water have been magically solidified into a glimmering, iridescent pinwheel that looks as fragile as glass. When affixed, it spins gently without a breeze. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 31.
- Armor You gain resistance 3 to persistent acid damage and persistent fire damage.

- Weapon After you cast a water spell by Activating the enduring helix, your Strikes with the weapon deal 1d6 persistent cold damage until the end of your next turn.
